svg.title: mod-builder: Mod Lab docked beside a Claude Code transcript, mid-build.
svg.desc: Describe a Claude Code mod in one sentence. Approve one spec. Get a tested, documented mod. A Claude Code window shows the prompt /mod-builder:build a band above the prompt showing the git branch, with Mod Lab beside it: four mods with stage lights, the demo mod aurora on the Register stage, a progress band above the prompt, and the status line reading 4 mods, 1 building.
